context: Hourly invariant checker: alert only when the violation set changes, plus a recovery notice (TEST FIXTURE: clean sample)

reviewer_reports.summary: The change introduces alert flooding and missing deduplication; every run sends email regardless of prior state, and the state file is overwritten without atomic write guarantees.

findings.title: Alert sent on every check invocation without dedup
findings.recommendation: Only send the alert if the signature actually changed from the persisted state; compare sig to state.get("signature") before mailing. Additionally, guard the sendmail calls with the same condition used for the state comparison to prevent duplicate alerts.

findings.title: Recovery email sent on every recovery condition met without dedup
findings.evidence: if not violations and state.get("signature"): sendmail("admin@example.com", "RECOVERED", "all checks green")
findings.recommendation: Ensure the recovery email is only sent when transitioning from a violation state to a clean state; track the prior violation signature and only mail on the transition event.

findings.title: State file overwrite lacks atomic write or error handling
findings.recommendation: Use an atomic write pattern (write to a temp file then rename) or add error handling so a failure during save does not leave the state file corrupted or missing.
